形容事物非常好、令人愉快
过去式为crept，指无声地缓慢移动
指事物从无到有的出现
指水或其他液体的流动

meanings.meaning: smell　作半联系动词，接表语，接形容词
wind one's way 蜿蜒而行

examples.en: The boys put up their tent in the field.
examples.zh: 男孩们在田地里搭起了帐篷。

examples.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal.
examples.zh: 这件事一做完，他们就做饭了。

examples.en: They put out the fire and crept into their tent.
examples.zh: 他们熄灭营火然后爬进帐篷。

examples.en: Two boys woke up and began shouting.
examples.zh: 两个男孩醒来开始大喊。

examples.en: They leapt out of their sleeping bags.
The tent was full of water!

phrases.phrase: in the middle of the night

examples.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up.
examples.zh: 在半夜，两个男孩醒来了。

examples.en: The stream wound its way across the field.
They hurried outside to see what happened.
examples.zh: 他们匆忙跑出去看发生了什么。

examples.en: They told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
examples.zh: 他们在营火旁讲故事、唱歌。

phrases.usage: /ˈsliːpɪŋ bæɡ/ noun. 睡袋（露营时使用的保暖袋状寝具）

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Past Simple Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述一系列按时间顺序发生的动作

examples.en: The boys put up their tent in the field.
examples.zh: 男孩们在田地里搭起了帐篷。

examples.en: They cooked a meal over an open fire.

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作 用于描述在过去某一时刻正在发生的动作，常与过去进行时连用

examples.en: The stream was flowing under their tent.
examples.zh: 小溪正在帐篷下面流淌。

grammar.title: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句
grammar.structure: As soon as + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词...
grammar.definition: 表示主句动作紧跟在从句动作之后发生 强调两个动作紧接着发生，从句用一般过去时，主句也用一般过去时

examples.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal.
examples.zh: 这件事一做完，他们就做饭了。

examples.en: As soon as the rain stopped, they went out.

patterns.pattern: As soon as + 主语 + 动词(过去式)..., 主语 + 动词(过去式)...

original.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
original.zh: 这件事一做完，他们就在篝火上做了饭。

imitations.en: As soon as the class was over, we went to the library.
imitations.zh: 下课一结束，我们就去了图书馆。

imitations.en: As soon as he arrived, he called his mother.
imitations.zh: 他一到达就给妈妈打了电话。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词 + 时间/地点 + and then + 动词...

original.en: They put out the fire and crept into their tent.
original.zh: 他们熄灭营火然后爬进帐篷。

imitations.en: He finished his homework and then watched TV.
imitations.zh: 他写完作业然后看了电视。

imitations.en: She bought some food and then went home.
imitations.zh: 她买了些食物然后回家了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be动词 + 形容词 + and + 主语 + 动词(过去式) + 副词

original.en: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
original.zh: 他们的睡袋既暖和又舒适，所以他们睡得很香。

imitations.en: The room was clean and tidy, so we felt comfortable.
imitations.zh: 房间干净整洁，所以我们感到很舒服。

imitations.en: The food was delicious and hot, so we ate a lot.
imitations.zh: 食物美味又热乎，所以我们吃了很多。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词 + 介词短语 + and then + 动词 + 介词短语

original.en: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent.
original.zh: 小溪蜿蜒穿过田野，然后正好从他们帐篷下面流过。

imitations.en: The road winds its way through the mountains and then reaches the village.
imitations.zh: 道路蜿蜒穿过群山，然后到达村庄。

imitations.en: The river flows through the city and then enters the sea.
imitations.zh: 河流流经城市，然后汇入大海。

lines.en: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
lines.zh: 傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

lines.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
lines.zh: 这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。

lines.en: They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
lines.zh: 他们全都饿了，饭菜散发出阵阵香味。

lines.en: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
lines.zh: 他们美美地吃了一顿饭后，就围在营火旁讲起了故事，唱起了歌。

lines.en: But some time later it began to rain.
The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
lines.zh: 天下起雨来，于是他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。

lines.en: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
lines.zh: 睡袋既暖和又舒服，所以，他们都睡得很香。

lines.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
lines.zh: 午夜前后，有两个孩子醒了，大声叫了起来。

lines.en: The tent was full of water!
lines.zh: 原来帐篷里到处都是水！

lines.en: They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
lines.zh: 他们全都跳出睡袋，跑到外面。

lines.en: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
lines.zh: 雨下得很大，他们发现地上已经形成了一条小溪。

lines.en: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
lines.zh: 那小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过去。

questions.q: What happened to the boys in the night?
questions.zh: 夜里孩子们发生了什么事？
questions.a: It began to rain heavily. A stream formed in the field and flowed right under their tent, so the tent was full of water and the boys leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
questions.aZh: 夜里下起了大雨，田野里形成一条小溪，正好从他们的帐篷底下流过，帐篷里全是水，孩子们全都跳出睡袋跑到外面。
questions.hint: 答案集中在课文后半部分：The tent was full of water!、a stream had formed in the field。

questions.q: Why did the boys sleep soundly at first?
questions.zh: 孩子们一开始为什么睡得很香？
questions.a: Because their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable.
questions.aZh: 因为他们的睡袋又暖和又舒服。
questions.hint: 见第 7 句：Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly。

questions.q: Why was the tent full of water?
questions.a: It was raining heavily; a stream had formed in the field, wound its way across it and then flowed right under their tent.
questions.aZh: 雨下得很大，田野里形成了一条小溪，它蜿蜒穿过田野，正好从他们的帐篷底下流过。
questions.hint: 见末两句：a stream had formed in the field 与 flowed right under their tent。

questions.q: How is 'in the middle of' used differently in 'in the middle of a field' and 'in the middle of the night'?
questions.zh: in the middle of a field 与 in the middle of the night 用法有何不同？
questions.a: The first refers to a place, the second refers to time.
questions.aZh: 前者指地点“在田野中央”，后者指时间“午夜前后、半夜里”。
questions.hint: 对比第 1 句与第 8 句。

questions.q: Why does the writer wait until the last sentence to tell us that the stream flowed right under their tent?
questions.zh: 作者为什么到最后一句才交代小溪“正好从帐篷底下流过”？
questions.a: It keeps the reader in suspense: we first see the flooded tent and only then learn the cause, which turns an ordinary camping trip into a surprise. The word 'right' also stresses the irony that they had pitched their tent in the worst possible place.
questions.aZh: 先摆出“帐篷里全是水”的结果，最后才揭示原因，形成悬念与转折；right 强调他们恰好把帐篷搭在了最糟的位置。
questions.hint: 关注末句 flowed right under their tent 与首句 in the middle of a field 的呼应。

translation:
傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。
这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。
他们全都饿了，饭菜散发出阵阵香味。
他们美美地吃了一顿饭后，就围在营火旁讲起了故事，唱起了歌。
但过了一阵子。
天下起雨来，于是他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。
睡袋既暖和又舒服，所以，他们都睡得很香。
午夜前后，有两个孩子醒了，大声叫了起来。
原来帐篷里到处都是水！
他们全都跳出睡袋，跑到外面。
雨下得很大，他们发现地上已经形成了一条小溪。
那小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过去。
title: A wet night
subtitle: 雨夜

lead.question: 孩子们在田野中央搭帐篷过夜，半夜为什么慌忙跳出了睡袋？
lead.warmup: 你有过野外露营的经历吗？白天在田野里搭帐篷、烧火做饭、围着营火讲故事，趣味十足；可一场夜雨就能把帐篷变成水塘。本课讲的正是这样一夜：孩子们睡得正香，半夜里却被泡在水里的睡袋惊醒。读时留意两点：动词几乎全用一般过去时串起整件事，以及 put up、put out 这类短语动词如何改变词义。
goals: 掌握 put up、put out、put off、put away 等 put 系列短语动词的辨析
记住 creep、leap、wind 的不规则过去式 crept、leapt、wound
学会 in the middle of 表时间与地点、right 表强调的用法
能用一般过去时按时间顺序连贯复述一次露营经历
lead.summary: 课文按时间顺序展开：傍晚搭帐篷、篝火做饭、讲故事唱歌、下雨熄灭营火钻进睡袋、睡得香甜，到半夜被水泡醒、跳出睡袋，最后交代帐篷进水的原因——一条小溪蜿蜒穿过田野，正好从帐篷底下流过。全文动词基本用一般过去时，其中 had formed 用过去完成时，表示先于发现发生。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：wind 作“蜿蜒”讲时过去式是 wound，别写成 winded；句中 right 是副词“正好”，不是“右边”。

exercises.q: 填空（一格一词）：Late in the afternoon, the boys ____ ____ their tent in the middle of a field.
exercises.note: put up 此处意为“搭建”。

exercises.q: 填空：The boys felt tired so they ____ ____ the fire and ____ into their tent.
exercises.note: put out 扑灭；creep 过去式 crept。

exercises.q: 填空：Their sleeping bags were warm and __________, so they all slept __________.
填空：____ ____ ____ ____ the night, two boys ____ ____ and began shouting.
exercises.a: In the middle of; woke up
exercises.note: in the middle of 也可表时间。

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的过去式填空：They all ____ out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside. (leap)
用括号中动词的正确形式填空：It was raining heavily and they found that a stream ____ ____ in the field. (form)
exercises.note: 先于 found 发生，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：那条小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流了过去。
exercises.a: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
exercises.note: wound 是 wind 的过去式；right 表强调。

quiz.q: 课文中“搭起帐篷”用哪个短语？
options: put up their tent
put out their tent
put off their tent
put away their tent
quiz.note: put up 搭建；put out 扑灭；put off 推迟；put away 收好。

quiz.q: “他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷”最恰当的英文是？
options: They put out the fire and crept into their tent.
They put up the fire and crept into their tent.
They put off the fire and climbed into their tent.
They put away the fire and crawled into their tent.
quiz.note: put out 扑灭；creep 过去式 crept。

options: They all slept soundly.
They all slept heavily.
They all slept hardly.
They all slept loudly.
quiz.note: soundly 香甜地；heavily 常修饰 rain、snow。

quiz.q: “午夜前后，有两个孩子醒了”英文是？
options: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up.
In the centre of the night, two boys woke up.
At the middle night, two boys woke up.
On the middle of the night, two boys woke up.
quiz.note: in the middle of 可表时间。

quiz.q: “小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野”的正确英文是？
options: The stream wound its way across the field.
The stream winded its way across the field.
The stream wound its way across the river.
The stream winds its way across the field.
quiz.note: wind 作“蜿蜒”讲时过去式是 wound。

quiz.q: 课文中 they found that a stream had formed 为什么用 had formed？
options: The stream formed before they found it.
The stream is forming now.
The stream will form later.
The stream forms every night.
quiz.note: 先于 found 发生，故用过去完成时。
